plans.rationale: A gain retune for the affected zone can compensate the insulation loss while keeping temperatures below the safety limit, and is less disruptive than derating or shutdown.

Derating zone 4 (affected by insulation loss) by lowering its setpoint within the 15 °C limit keeps its temperature well below the safety limit and restores regulation without shutting down the plant.

actions.rationale: Insulation loss in zone 3 (and neighbour zone 2) requires stronger proportional action. Raising Kc from 4 %/°C to 6 %/°C stays within [0.5,20] and keeps tauI at 120 s (within [20,600]). No other fields are changed in RETUNE mode.

Zone 3 shows a large negative residual (‑11.7 °C) indicating insulation loss. To keep it within the safety limit we lower its setpoint by the maximum allowed 15 °C (45→30) and cap its heater output at 50 % (q_max). Zone 2 is neighboring and may share heat, so we modestly reduce its q_max to 80 % while leaving its setpoint unchanged.
